metadata.title_zh: 臺灣景點歷史沿革與文化旅遊資料庫

location.address_zh: 臺南市中西區民族路二段212號
location.address_en: No. 212, Sec. 2, Minzu Rd., West Central Dist., Tainan City

summary.zh_TW: 原為荷蘭人所建之普羅民遮城，歷經明鄭最高行政中樞與清代中式樓閣改建，是臺灣歷史更迭最具代表性的地標之一。
summary.en: Originally built by the Dutch East India Company as Fort Provintia in 1653, this landmark later served as Koxinga's supreme government center and was transformed into classical Chinese pavilions during the Qing Dynasty.

historical_narrative.zh_TW: 1653年郭懷一抗荷事件平息後，荷蘭人為了強化對漢人與原住民的防禦並掌控台江內海航道，建立了『普羅民遮城』（Fort Provintia，漢人俗稱紅毛樓或赤崁樓）。1661年鄭成功率軍東征，登陸鹿耳門後隨即攻下赤崁樓，並以此作為全島最高行政中心『承天府署』。進入清領時期後，原荷式紅毛樓建築因地震與風雨逐漸倒塌。19世紀末，清廷地方官員在荷蘭城堡的磚石殘基之上陸續興建了文昌閣、海神廟、蓬壺書院等傳統閩南風格閣樓。日治時期歷經整修與考古挖掘，使底層厚實的荷蘭磚紅基座與上方飛簷翹角的漢式樓閣融為一體。
historical_narrative.en: In 1653, following the Guo Huai-yi peasant rebellion, the Dutch VOC built Fort Provintia to control the inland Taijiang lagoon and administrative quarters. In 1661, General Koxinga (Zheng Chenggong) besieged the fortress, establishing his seat of government (Chengtian Prefecture). During the Qing Dynasty, earthquakes decimated the original European structures. In the late 19th century, Qing magistrates built classical Chinese pavilions—the Haishen (Sea God) Temple and Wenchang Pavilion—directly on top of the ancient Dutch red-brick bastions. The site is famous for its harmonious juxtaposition of 17th-century European bastion foundations and Qing-dynasty imperial architecture.

timeline.event_zh: 荷蘭東印度公司建成普羅民遮城（Provintia），作為商業管理與防衛中心。
timeline.event_en: Dutch East India Company erected Fort Provintia as their administrative stronghold.

timeline.event_zh: 鄭成功收復臺灣，設赤崁樓為承天府，為治理臺灣的政治中樞。
timeline.event_en: Koxinga captured Fort Provintia, designating it the supreme prefecture government office.

timeline.event_zh: 清乾隆帝平定林爽文事件後，賜御製馱碑贔屭石龜九座安置於赤崁樓。
timeline.event_en: Emperor Qianlong bestowed nine imperial honorific turtle-base steles (Bixi) following the pacification of the Lin Shuangwen rebellion.

timeline.event_zh: 台灣知縣沈受謙於荷蘭古基上改建海神廟與文昌閣。
timeline.event_en: Magistrate Shen Shou-qian constructed Chinese classical pavilions (Sea God Temple & Wenchang Pavilion) over the ruins.

timeline.event_zh: 日本學者與地方當局拆除雜建，發掘並修復荷蘭原始城壁棱堡殘跡。
timeline.event_en: Japanese architectural historians excavated and conserved the original Dutch bastion masonry walls.

cultural_significance.why_it_matters_zh: 赤崁樓是臺南作為臺灣古都的核心地標，凝結了荷蘭航海帝國、明鄭反清復明復興基地與清朝地方文教治理三重重大歷史意義。
cultural_significance.why_it_matters_en: Chihkan Tower is the quintessential cultural icon of Tainan, encapsulating three foundational epochs of Taiwan: the Dutch maritime empire, Koxinga's Southern Ming loyalist stronghold, and Qing imperial governance.
cultural_significance.architectural_highlights_zh: 現存珍貴荷蘭原始紅磚稜堡遺跡（以糯米、糖水、蚵灰三合土砌築）、九座乾隆御賜贔屭御碑、文昌閣魁星爺雕像、瓶形門與斷足石馬。
cultural_significance.architectural_highlights_en: Key features include the surviving Dutch bastion wall constructed with traditional mortar composed of glutinous rice, sugar syrup, and crushed oyster shells; nine majestic Imperial Qianlong Bixi (dragon-headed turtle) granite steles; and the intricately carved Kuixing deity shrine worshiped by students for academic success.
cultural_significance.intangible_culture_zh: 全臺考生祈求魁星爺金榜題名的信仰中心，以及台南中西區文史小吃聚落的核心源頭。
cultural_significance.intangible_culture_en: A revered pilgrimage spot where students and scholars pray to the God of Examinations (Kuixing) for academic and career breakthroughs.

foreign_visitor_guide.etiquette_tips_en: When visiting the Wenchang Pavilion on the second floor, speak quietly out of respect for worshippers. Rubbing the nose of the Qianlong turtle steles is traditionally believed to bring luck, but please touch gently without scratching the stone surfaces.
foreign_visitor_guide.etiquette_tips_zh: 參觀二樓文昌閣與魁星殿時請放低音量以示尊重。園區草坪與古蹟本體請愛護維護。
must_see_spots_en: Original 17th-century Dutch brick bastion gate and underground passageway entrance
Row of 9 imperial dragon-turtle (Bixi) steles granted by Emperor Qianlong
Statue and shrine of Kui Xing holding a calligraphy brush atop an Ao fish
Penghu Academy (Penghu Shuyuan) gate and surviving Qing wooden structure
must_see_spots_zh: 荷蘭時代原始普羅民遮城紅磚城門與神秘地道傳說入口
乾隆御製九座贔屭馱碑群
二樓文昌閣魁星爺神像與祈願魁星筆
蓬壺書院遺存門廳與清代儒學講堂遺跡
foreign_visitor_guide.transportation_en: From Tainan Railway Station, walk 15 minutes down Chenggong Road or take City Bus No. 3, 5, 88, or 99 directly to 'Chihkan Tower' (赤崁樓) stop.
foreign_visitor_guide.transportation_zh: 由臺南火車站前站出發，步行約15分鐘，或搭乘大台南公車3路、5路、88路、99路至『赤崁樓』站即達。
foreign_visitor_guide.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon leading into nightfall; the complex is beautifully illuminated with atmospheric spotlights after 6:00 PM.

metadata.source: Tainan City Cultural Affairs Bureau & Bureau of Cultural Heritage

name.zh_TW: 大稻埕迪化街歷史街區

location.address_zh: 臺北市大同區迪化街一段
location.address_en: Sec. 1, Dihua St., Datong Dist., Taipei City

attractions.heritage_status: Historic Settlement & Heritage Street Preservation Zone (歷史聚落與文化資產保存區)

summary.zh_TW: 清末開港茶葉外銷全世界的起點，擁有全臺保存最完整的巴洛克與閩南長條街屋，匯聚中藥、南北貨、布匹與當代文創新生命。
summary.en: The epicenter of Taiwan's 19th-century Formosa Oolong tea boom. Home to the island's best-preserved Baroque-revival and Southern Fujianese shophouse streetscapes, bustling with Chinese herbal medicine, dried delicacies, textiles, and artisanal cafes.

historical_narrative.zh_TW: 1853年艋舺爆發嚴重的『頂下郊拚』械鬥，落敗的同安人由林佑藻率領帶著霞海城隍神像撤遷至大稻埕，因臨近淡水河碼頭腹地而迅速崛起。1860年天津條約臺灣正式開港通商，英商杜德（John Dodd）引進安溪茶苗並在大稻埕設茶廠精製『福爾摩沙烏龍茶（Formosa Oolong Tea）』直銷歐美，讓大稻埕迅速成為臺灣面向世界的首富之地與各國領事洋行聚集所。日治時期實施市區改正，富裕的布商、中藥商與南北貨行家競相在迪化街興建華麗的仿巴洛克山牆與洗石子洋樓。現今迪化街完整保留了深達數十公尺、前店中坊後倉的傳統長條形街屋，並轉型為結合傳統老行號與青年文創咖啡空間的迷人街區。
historical_narrative.en: Following the 1853 immigrant clash in Bangka, refugees led by Lin You-zao settled along the tranquil Tamsui riverside, founding Dadaocheng ('Large Rice-Drying Field'). When the port opened to Western trade in 1860, Scottish merchant John Dodd and tea master Li Chun-sheng pioneered the export of premium Formosa Oolong tea to New York and London, sparking Taiwan's tea golden age. Dadaocheng swiftly surpassed Bangka as Taipei's richest cosmopolitan quarter, hosting European consulates, shipping firms, and opera theaters. During the Japanese colonial period, prosperous textile and herbal medicine tycoons adorned Dihua Street with elaborate Baroque-style pediments and ornate stucco relief. Today, the 3-entry deep shophouses remain vibrant living heritage.

timeline.event_zh: 頂下郊拚事件後，同安人移居大稻埕建街，形成中街、南街早期聚落。
timeline.event_en: Settlers founded commercial rows following the Bangka conflict, building early shophouses.

timeline.event_zh: 約翰·杜德載運兩艘帆船的福爾摩沙烏龍茶直銷紐約獲空前好評，開啟臺灣茶葉黃金年代。
timeline.event_en: John Dodd shipped Formosa Oolong to New York, unleashing the global Taiwanese tea boom.

timeline.event_zh: 日治市區改正，茶商、布行與藥商興建精雕細琢之仿巴洛克洋樓立面。
timeline.event_en: Urban redesign created grand Baroque and Art Deco stucco facades with family crests.

timeline.event_zh: 發起『我愛迪化街』保存運動，成功阻止拆除拓寬，轉型為全臺首座歷史風貌保存特區。
timeline.event_en: Citizens and architects halted demolition, establishing Taiwan's premier historic preservation zone.

cultural_significance.why_it_matters_zh: 見證臺灣近代商業文明萌芽、全球化茶葉貿易與現代化市民文化的活態歷史街區。
cultural_significance.why_it_matters_en: A vibrant living testimony to Taiwan's integration into global trade, East-meets-West architecture, and mercantile culture.
cultural_significance.architectural_highlights_zh: 閩南式瓦頂街屋、仿巴洛克山牆雕飾（鮑魚勳章飾、麒麟琴棋書畫商標）、現代主義折衷洗石子立面、三進式狹長天井街屋建築。
cultural_significance.architectural_highlights_en: Four distinct architectural styles along one corridor: Southern Fujianese brick cottages, Western Baroque pediments with ornate merchant crests, Japanese Showa-period modernism, and traditional 3-courtyard elongated shophouses featuring hidden tranquil atriums (Tianjing).
cultural_significance.intangible_culture_zh: 每年農曆年前全臺規模最大之『年貨大街』，以及台北霞海城隍廟月老牽紅線祈求良緣之信仰熱潮。
cultural_significance.intangible_culture_en: The exuberant Lunar New Year Market (Nianhuo Dajie) and Taipei Xiahai City God Temple, globally famous for its matchmaker deity (Yuelao) uniting souls in love.

foreign_visitor_guide.etiquette_tips_en: Many herbal medicine and dry goods shops display free samples of dried fruit, nuts, and herbal tea—feel free to taste respectfully before purchasing. If visiting the famous Xiahai City God Temple to pray for love, follow the English guide brochure available at the reception counter.
foreign_visitor_guide.etiquette_tips_zh: 中藥南北貨老店常提供果乾茶飲試吃，請禮貌品嚐。霞海城隍廟求姻緣流程備有英文解說單，可向廟方服務處洽詢。
must_see_spots_en: Taipei Xiahai City God Temple (famed worldwide for the Chinese Matchmaker God Yuelao)
Traditional 3-courtyard historic shophouses with hidden garden cafes and tea studios
Yongle Fabric Market (Taiwan's largest textile and tailor paradise)
Dadaocheng Wharf (Pier 5 container market and sunset bike path along Tamsui River)
must_see_spots_zh: 台北霞海城隍廟（月老靈驗享譽國際）
三進式長條老街屋天井文創茶館（如合勝堂、進益採買等）
永樂布業商場（全臺最大布料批發與旗袍手工藝中心）
大稻埕碼頭（PIER5貨櫃市集與淡水河夕陽自行車道）
foreign_visitor_guide.transportation_en: Take Taipei MRT Green Line to 'Beimen Station' (Exit 3) or Orange Line to 'Daqiaotou Station' (Exit 1), followed by a 7-minute stroll into Dihua Street.
foreign_visitor_guide.transportation_zh: 搭乘台北捷運松山新店線至『北門站』3號出口，或中和新蘆線至『大橋頭站』1號出口，步行約7分鐘即達迪化街商圈。
foreign_visitor_guide.best_time_to_visit: Afternoon (1:00 PM - 6:00 PM) when all heritage cafes and boutiques are bustling, followed by river sunset at Dadaocheng Wharf.

metadata.source: Taipei City Department of Cultural Affairs & URS Historic Preservation Project

location.address_zh: 新北市淡水區中正路28巷1號
location.address_en: No. 1, Ln. 28, Zhongzheng Rd., Tamsui Dist., New Taipei City

summary.zh_TW: 坐落於淡水河口的戰略堡壘，見證近四百年大航海時代以來的政權更迭與北台灣對外貿易興衰。
summary.en: A legendary strategic fortress overlooking the Tamsui River mouth, witnessing nearly 400 years of geopolitical shifts, naval battles, and international diplomacy since the Age of Discovery.

historical_narrative.zh_TW: 淡水紅毛城最早由西班牙人於1628年建立，名為聖多明哥城（Fort San Domingo），作為鞏固北臺灣統治與貿易的據點。1642年荷蘭人將西班牙人逐出北臺灣後，在原地以堅固石材重建並命名為安東尼堡（Fort Antonio）。由於當時漢人稱荷蘭人為『紅毛番』，此堡壘遂被稱為『紅毛城』。歷經明鄭、清代改建並增設城門砲台，1867年英國政府向清廷租借該處作為英國領事館，並於主堡旁擴建紅磚拱廊洋樓作為領事官邸。這座古堡先後飄揚過西班牙、荷蘭、明鄭、清朝、英國、日本、澳大利亞、美國及中華民國共9面旗幟，堪稱臺灣近代史的縮影。
historical_narrative.en: Fort San Domingo was originally constructed with wood and earth in 1628 by the Spanish empire as a Northern Taiwan outpost to protect trade routes between Manila and Japan. In 1642, the Dutch East India Company expelled the Spanish and rebuilt a stone bastion named Fort Antonio in 1644. Taiwanese locals called the red-haired Dutch 'Hongmao', giving rise to the site's enduring moniker 'Hongmao Castle' (Red Hair Fort). Through the Qing Dynasty, it served as maritime coastal defense. In 1867, the British Empire leased the compound as their British Consulate, later erecting a stately Victorian red-brick consular residence with Victorian tilework. Nine sovereign flags have flown over this strategic hilltop across nearly four centuries.

timeline.event_zh: 西班牙人進駐淡水，建立木造聖多明哥城（San Domingo）。
timeline.event_en: Spanish conquistadors landed in Tamsui and erected the wooden Fort San Domingo.

timeline.event_zh: 荷蘭人擊退西班牙人後，以厚重石材重建安東尼堡（Fort Antonio）。
timeline.event_en: Dutch East India Company rebuilt the stone fortification and named it Fort Antonio.

timeline.event_zh: 淡水廳同知王汧重修紅毛城，並增築南門與東門等外牆防禦設施。
timeline.event_en: Qing officials refurbished the fort, adding defensive perimeter walls and gates.

timeline.event_zh: 英國政府簽署永久租約作為領事館，並將外牆粉刷為現今醒目的紅色。
timeline.event_en: British Empire signed a perpetual lease for the compound as a consular headquarters.

timeline.event_zh: 英國領事官邸落成，展現維多利亞紅磚迴廊建築美學。
timeline.event_en: The two-story Victorian consular residence with colonial verandahs was completed.

timeline.event_zh: 產權由中華民國政府正式收回，現開放為新北市立淡水古蹟博物館。
timeline.event_en: The property was officially returned to Taiwan and opened to the public as a living museum.

cultural_significance.why_it_matters_zh: 紅毛城是臺灣現存歷史最悠久的古蹟之一，具體展現了17世紀歐洲重商主義擴張、大航海時代的海洋地緣政治，以及19世紀開港通商後西方外交建築風格在臺灣的融合。
cultural_significance.why_it_matters_en: Fort San Domingo is one of Taiwan's oldest standing architectural complexes. It encapsulates 17th-century European mercantilism, Age of Discovery geopolitics, and 19th-century colonial diplomatic heritage.
cultural_significance.architectural_highlights_zh: 主堡牆厚達1.9公尺，具備防砲轟拱頂與地牢；領事官邸則呈現精湛的英國維多利亞風格，包括清水紅磚、綠釉花瓶欄杆、VR1891維多利亞女王徽號磚雕以及引進自英國的Minton地磚。
cultural_significance.architectural_highlights_en: The main fortress features 1.9-meter-thick stone walls with bombproof barrel-vaulted ceilings. The consular residence boasts classic British Victorian verandah architecture, VR 1891 monogram brick carvings, green glazed bottle balustrades, and authentic Victorian encaustic tiles imported from Britain.
cultural_significance.intangible_culture_zh: 見證淡水夕照與淡江水運的人文記憶，是淡水開港歷史的核心符號。
cultural_significance.intangible_culture_en: Symbolizes Tamsui's transformation from an aboriginal river port to an international tea and camphor export harbor.

foreign_visitor_guide.etiquette_tips_en: Wear comfortable walking shoes as the estate is built on a gentle slope with cobblestones. Photography is allowed, but flash is prohibited inside historic rooms. Preserved historical interior floors require shoe covers or adherence to designated pathways.
foreign_visitor_guide.etiquette_tips_zh: 園區包含坡道與石階步道，建議穿著舒適步行鞋。室內古蹟展廳禁止使用閃光燈，請依循導覽動線參觀。
must_see_spots_en: Dutch-era underground prison cells and defensive ramparts
Victorian consular dining room with English fireplace and Minton floor tiles
17th-century muzzle-loading bronze and iron cannons placed in the courtyard
Hilltop panoramic lookout facing the Tamsui River mouth and Mount Guanyin
must_see_spots_zh: 主堡荷蘭地牢與厚重穹頂防禦結構
英國領事官邸壁爐、僕役呼叫鈴與英國進口彩釉地磚
庭園中清代嘉慶年間鑄造的古砲群
俯瞰淡水河口與觀音山日落的眺望平台
foreign_visitor_guide.transportation_en: Take Taipei Metro (MRT) Red Line to the terminal 'Tamsui Station', then transfer to Bus R26, 836, or 857 to 'Fort San Domingo (紅毛城)' stop, or enjoy a scenic 15-minute riverside walk from the station.
foreign_visitor_guide.transportation_zh: 搭乘台北捷運淡水信義線至『淡水站』，轉乘公車紅26、836至『紅毛城(真理大學)站』，或沿淡水金色水岸步道步行約15分鐘。
foreign_visitor_guide.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon (3:30 PM - 5:30 PM) to catch the golden hour light on the red bricks and the famous Tamsui sunset.

metadata.source: Bureau of Cultural Heritage, Ministry of Culture, Taiwan & Tamsui Historical Museum

name.zh_TW: 九份山城與金瓜石礦業遺址
name.en: Jiufen Old Street & Jinguashi Gold Mountain

location.address_zh: 新北市瑞芳區基山街、豎崎路與金光路
location.address_en: Jishan St., Shuqi Rd. & Jinguang Rd., Ruifang Dist., New Taipei City

attractions.heritage_status: Cultural Heritage Landscape & World Heritage Potential Site (臺灣世界遺產潛力點)

summary.zh_TW: 從清末築路築鐵路意外發現金沙，到日治時期成為東亞第一金都『小香港』，現為依山傍海、茶香繚繞的懷舊文化山城。
summary.en: From late Qing railway workers discovering placer gold in 1890 to becoming 'Asia's Gold Capital' during the Japanese era, this mist-shrouded mountain settlement now captivates global travelers with its vertical stairways, teahouse culture, and cinematic nostalgia.

historical_narrative.zh_TW: 『九份』之名源自清代此地原本僅有九戶人家，每次對外採買日常物資皆需均分『九份』。1890年（光緒十六年），劉銘傳修築臺北至基隆鐵路工人於基隆河下游發現沙金，隨即掀起淘金熱潮，沿河上溯發現九份小金瓜金脈。1895年日本統治臺灣後，將礦權劃分給藤田組與顏雲年創辦之『臺陽礦業』，引進現代化坑道爆破與浮選冶煉技術，金瓜石與九份產金量躍居亞洲之冠，贏得『東亞第一金都』與入夜不夜城『小香港』稱號。1970年代金礦開採殆盡後一度沉寂，直到侯孝賢導演以此為背景拍攝威尼斯影展金獅獎電影《悲情城市》，以獨特的多雨石階梯、紅燈籠老茶樓與無敵山海景致重新驚豔全球。
historical_narrative.en: Originally a sleepy camphor-farming hamlet of just nine households ('Jiu Fen' literally means 'Nine Portions'), the area was transformed overnight in 1890 when railway workers building the Taipei-Keelung line stumbled upon placer gold flakes. During Japanese colonial rule, industrial extraction by Tanaka and the Taiwanese Taiyang Mining Company yielded unprecedented gold and copper tonnage, elevating Jinguashi-Jiufen to the premier gold producer in East Asia. After mines depleted in the 1970s, the mountain town gained global fame when visionary film director Hou Hsiao-hsien filmed the Venice Golden Lion winner 'A City of Sadness' (1989) here, celebrating its atmospheric staircases, lantern-lit hillside teahouses, and cinematic coastal mist.

timeline.event_zh: 基隆河工人在七堵鐵橋下發現砂金，開啟九份金瓜石淘金熱潮。
timeline.event_en: Railway laborers discovered gold flakes in the river, sparking the Great Gold Rush.

timeline.event_zh: 日本政府頒布臺灣礦業條例，藤田組與田中組進駐現代化機械開採。
timeline.event_en: Japanese mining conglomerates mechanized extraction, producing tons of pure gold.

timeline.event_zh: 顏雲年向日商租賃九份礦區，奠定臺灣本土採礦龍頭『臺陽礦業』王國。
timeline.event_en: Industrialist Yen Yun-nien founded Taiyang Mining, sharing wealth with local miners.

timeline.event_zh: 金礦產量枯竭，台金公司與臺陽礦業陸續停採，山城歸於平靜。
timeline.event_en: Mining operations ceased, entering a quiet two-decade interlude.

timeline.event_zh: 電影《悲情城市》榮獲威尼斯影展金獅獎，帶動九份國際觀光文藝復興。
timeline.event_en: Hou Hsiao-hsien's film 'A City of Sadness' won the Venice Golden Lion, sparking a global renaissance.

cultural_significance.why_it_matters_zh: 記錄了臺灣近代工業採礦、礦工奮鬥史以及從工業採礦重鎮轉型為國際知性觀光聚落的代表性軌跡。
cultural_significance.why_it_matters_en: A rare preserved mining landscape capturing Taiwan's industrial resilience, traditional hillside vernacular architecture, and film heritage.
cultural_significance.architectural_highlights_zh: 依山面海的階梯式立體聚落、黑色油毛氈『黑紙頂』防雨屋頂、豎崎路陡峭石階與兩側紅燈籠老茶樓、金瓜石日式木造四連棟宿舍群。
cultural_significance.architectural_highlights_en: Steep hillside terraces connected by 300+ vertical stone steps; black asphalt tar-paper roofs (Hei Zhi Ding) designed to repel torrential monsoon rains; glowing red silk lanterns; and preserved 1930s Japanese timber official residences at the Gold Museum.
cultural_significance.intangible_culture_zh: 九份獨特的慢活品茗茶藝文化、芋圓傳統手工點心與金瓜石煉金淘金工藝傳承。
cultural_significance.intangible_culture_en: Gongfu tea brewing traditions overlooking the Pacific, handmade taro balls (Yu Yuan), and gold-panning demonstrations.

foreign_visitor_guide.etiquette_tips_en: Jiufen's famous Shuqi Road consists of over 300 steep stone steps that can become slippery on rainy days. Wear non-slip walking shoes and bring an umbrella. Traditional teahouses generally charge a nominal table/tea fee per person for an authentic Gongfu tea ceremony experience.
foreign_visitor_guide.etiquette_tips_zh: 豎崎路皆為陡峭石階，雨天路面濕滑請務必穿著防滑平底鞋並備雨具。茶藝館多依人頭計茶水費，可體驗正統功夫茶道。
must_see_spots_en: Shuqi Road stone stairways illuminated by glowing red lanterns at twilight
A-Mei Teahouse (famed for its nostalgic tiered wooden structure overlooking the sea)
Shengping Theater (Taiwan's earliest modern theater in mining history, built in 1934)
Jinguashi Gold Museum (touch a 220kg 99.9% pure solid gold bullion ingot)
must_see_spots_zh: 豎崎路陡峭階梯與傍晚點亮之紅燈籠
阿妹茶樓與九份海景品茗時光
昇平戲院（1934年建造之北臺灣最早現代戲院）
金瓜石黃金博物館（親手觸摸220公斤999純金大金磚與日式四連棟）
foreign_visitor_guide.transportation_en: Take Taipei MRT Blue/Brown Line to 'Zhongxiao Fuxing Station' (Exit 2) and ride Keelung Bus 1062 directly to Jiufen Old Street (approx. 70 mins), or take TRA Train to Ruifang Station and transfer to Bus 788, 827, or 965.
foreign_visitor_guide.transportation_zh: 搭乘台北捷運至『忠孝復興站』2號出口轉乘基隆客運1062直達九份老街；或搭火車至瑞芳站轉乘公車788、827、965號。
foreign_visitor_guide.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon (4:00 PM - 8:00 PM) to watch sunset turn into twilight when red lanterns illuminate the mountain.

metadata.source: New Taipei City Tourism and Travel Department & Gold Museum

location.address_zh: 彰化縣鹿港鎮金門街109號
location.address_en: No. 109, Jinmen St., Lukang Township, Changhua County

summary.zh_TW: 臺灣現存規模最宏偉、工藝最精湛的清代閩南木構佛寺，享有『臺灣紫禁城』與『民間藝術殿堂』之盛譽。
summary.en: Taiwan's most intact, magnificent, and artistically sophisticated Qing-dynasty Southern Fujianese Buddhist temple, widely acclaimed as the 'Forbidden City of Taiwan'.

historical_narrative.zh_TW: 鹿港在清領乾隆至道光年間為臺灣中部最繁華的對渡商港，有『一府二鹿三艋舺』之美譽。西元1786年（乾隆五十一年），泉州泉安移民將原大有街之舊廟遷建至現金門街現址，並由鹿港八郊行商與士紳出資，延聘泉州惠安頂級木雕大師與匠師，採用珍貴福建杉木、泉州白石與青斗石精心營建。龍山寺主祀觀世音菩薩，全寺格局三進二院，佔地一千六百多坪，寺內的戲台八卦藻井更是臺灣現存年代最早且跨距最大的頂級木作藻井藝術，全程不耗一釘一鐵，純以精密榫卯斗栱懸臂疊組而成。
historical_narrative.en: During the 18th and 19th centuries, Lukang was Taiwan's premier trading port with mainland China, giving rise to the famous historical adage: 'First Tainan, Second Lukang, Third Bangka (Taipei)'. In 1786, wealthy Lukang merchant guilds (Eight Suburbs Guilds) financed the relocation and expansion of Longshan Temple to its current site. Master craftsmen from Quanzhou, Fujian were commissioned to construct this temple compound using imported granite, bluestone, and aged Chinese fir timbers. Dedicated to Guanyin (Avalokiteshvara), the complex spans over 5,000 square meters. Its theatrical stage features a world-renowned Octagonal Caisson Ceiling (Zaojing) assembled entirely with interlocking mortise-and-tenon joints without a single metallic nail.

timeline.event_zh: 泉州僧侶肇善禪師迎奉觀音大士神像至鹿港大有街創建草創小廟。
timeline.event_en: Monk Zhaoshan brought Guanyin statues from Mount Putuo to found an early shrine.

timeline.event_zh: 由鹿港八郊商賈士紳合資遷建於現址，奠定今日宏偉三進院落基礎。
timeline.event_en: Merchant guilds funded the relocation to current site with full three-hall courtyard layout.

timeline.event_zh: 大規模擴建拜殿、戲台及八卦藻井，集結兩岸頂尖唐山匠師施作。
timeline.event_en: Major expansion constructed the grand prayer pavilion and the masterpiece octagonal caisson ceiling.

timeline.event_zh: 九二一大地震受損，隨後展開歷時數年、被譽為臺灣古蹟修復典範的跨國修復工程。
timeline.event_en: Underwent landmark heritage restoration following the 1999 Jiji Earthquake, setting national conservation standards.

cultural_significance.why_it_matters_zh: 臺灣傳統木構建築工藝與佛道宗教美學的最高顛峰，承載清代海商貿易黃金時期的精緻文化品味。
cultural_significance.why_it_matters_en: Represents the supreme zenith of traditional Chinese timber-frame engineering and liturgical decorative arts in Taiwan, preserved with astonishing authenticity.
cultural_significance.architectural_highlights_zh: 戲台上方懸臂式十六組斗栱旋轉交疊形成的八卦藻井、三川殿五門木雕隔扇花鳥人物、清代彩繪大師郭新林之門神彩繪、泉州石雕龍柱與青斗石石獅。
cultural_significance.architectural_highlights_en: The gravity-defying Octagonal Spiderweb Caisson Ceiling above the theatrical stage; exquisite Qing openwork latticed timber screens depicting floral and mythological motifs; authentic hand-painted Door Gods by master painter Guo Xin-lin; and hand-carved 18th-century Quanzhou bluestone dragon pillars.
cultural_significance.intangible_culture_zh: 鹿港雅正優雅的南管音樂演奏發源地之一，伴隨古剎暮鼓晨鐘悠揚迴盪。
cultural_significance.intangible_culture_en: Traditional Nanguan (Southern Pipes) classical chamber music is frequently performed here, harmonizing with gentle temple gongs.

foreign_visitor_guide.etiquette_tips_en: Longshan Temple is an active Buddhist sanctuary. Speak in hushed tones. When entering any threshold, step OVER the wooden threshold bar—never step ON it (stepping on thresholds is considered disrespectful in East Asian architecture).
foreign_visitor_guide.etiquette_tips_zh: 請放低交談音量。跨越門檻時切勿踩踏門檻（踩門檻在東方習俗代表不敬），請直接跨步而過。
must_see_spots_en: The jaw-dropping Octagonal Caisson Ceiling (look straight up beneath the theater stage)
Three-Bay Five-Door Front Hall featuring intricate openwork wood relief panels
Qing-dynasty solid bluestone guardian lions with smiling masculine/feminine expressions
The peaceful Rear Hall courtyard with ancient banyan trees and stone water cisterns
must_see_spots_zh: 戲台正上方八卦八角迴旋式懸臂藻井（臺灣木構極品）
三川殿五門木雕隔扇鏤空透雕
三川殿前清代青斗石刻抱鼓石與石獅
後殿寧靜後花園與古井庭院
foreign_visitor_guide.transportation_en: Take Taiwan High Speed Rail to Taichung Station, then transfer to Changhua Bus No. 6936 (Taiwan Tourist Shuttle Lukang Line) directly to Lukang, followed by a 10-minute walk through the heritage alleyways.
foreign_visitor_guide.transportation_zh: 搭乘高鐵至台中站，轉乘彰化客運6936（台灣好行鹿港祈福線）至鹿港，步行約10分鐘即可到達。
foreign_visitor_guide.best_time_to_visit: Mid-morning (9:00 AM - 11:30 AM) when gentle sunlight beams filter through the incense smoke and timber latticework.

metadata.source: Lukang Longshan Temple Foundation & Bureau of Cultural Heritage

name.en: Tainan Confucius Temple (First Academy of Taiwan)

location.address_zh: 臺南市中西區南門路2號
location.address_en: No. 2, Nanmen Rd., West Central Dist., Tainan City

summary.zh_TW: 建於明鄭時期西元1665年，為臺灣最早建立的孔廟與最高官辦學府，尊稱『全臺首學』，承載數百年儒家禮樂文教根基。
summary.en: Erected in 1665 during the Kingdom of Tungning, this is Taiwan's earliest Confucius Temple and premier imperial academy. Revered as the 'First Academy of Taiwan', it is the cradle of classical Confucian education and ritual music.

historical_narrative.zh_TW: 西元1665年（明永曆十九年），鄭成功之子鄭經採納謀士陳永華『建聖廟、設學校』的建言，在承天府桂仔埔興建了臺灣歷史上第一座孔廟及附屬官學（太學），開創了臺灣系統性科舉教育與儒家文化體系之先河。進入清領時期後，康熙帝派施琅進駐臺灣，孔廟獲歷代清朝皇帝御賜尊號與匾額，並改為『臺灣府學』。清康熙至光緒年間，八位皇帝親筆賜匾懸掛於大成殿內；民國以降歷任總統亦依例賜匾，形成全臺絕無僅有、貫穿四百年政權遞嬗的珍貴御匾典藏群。每年孔子誕辰舉辦之釋奠大典，完整保存了極為罕見的明清宮廷雅樂與六佾舞儀軌。
historical_narrative.en: In 1665, during the reign of Zheng Jing (son of General Koxinga), prime advisor Chen Yong-hua advocated building a sacred temple and imperial school to lay the foundation for civic education on the island. This marked the birth of institutionalized civil service examination training and Confucian humanism in Taiwan. Following the Qing takeover, Emperor Kangxi refurbished the complex into the Taiwan Prefectural Academy. Successive Qing Emperors (from Kangxi, Yongzheng, Qianlong through Guangxu) personally bestowed imperial calligraphic honor boards ('plagues') to hang inside the Dacheng Hall—a tradition continued by Presidents in modern Taiwan. The annual autumn Confucius Memorial Ceremony retains centuries-old ritual court music, incense offerings, and ceremonial 6-row dancer rituals (Liu Yi Wu).

timeline.event_zh: 諮議參軍陳永華倡議興建聖廟與官學，為全臺文教之始。
timeline.event_en: Advisor Chen Yong-hua established the Confucius Temple and the First Academy.

timeline.event_zh: 清朝設臺灣府，將孔廟改制為臺灣府學，頒賜『萬世師表』等御匾。
timeline.event_en: Qing court designated the site as Taiwan Prefectural School and bestowed imperial plaques.

timeline.event_zh: 巡道陳璸重修大成殿、明倫堂及文昌閣，確立『左學右廟』之完整格局。
timeline.event_en: Refurbished into the traditional architectural layout of 'School on the Left, Temple on the Right'.

timeline.event_zh: 日治時期官方實施大整修，保存清代原始木作構件與石雕精髓。
timeline.event_en: Japanese administration undertook comprehensive conservation of the classical wooden timber structures.

timeline.event_zh: 每年9月28日清晨舉行隆重古禮秋祭大典，全臺矚目。
timeline.event_en: Hosts the prestigious dawn autumn Confucius Rite every September 28th following archaic Ming-Qing ritual protocols.

cultural_significance.why_it_matters_zh: 代表漢人儒家教育在臺灣生根發芽的起點，是臺灣儒學傳統、科舉制度與古代禮樂制度最權威的活化石。
cultural_significance.why_it_matters_en: The spiritual birthplace of Taiwan's literary scholarship and civil service exams, maintaining living traditions of ancient East Asian ceremonial rites.
cultural_significance.architectural_highlights_zh: 經典『左學右廟』佈局、大成殿重簷歇山頂、朱紅沈穩色調、無雕龍畫棟的肅穆文廟風格、大成門與泮池、大成殿內懸掛的清代至當代完整御匾收藏。
cultural_significance.architectural_highlights_en: Distinctive deep terracotta-red walls symbolizing scholarly solemnity; sweeping double-eaved hip-and-gable roof on Dacheng Hall; no painted human deity statues (only ancestral spirit tablets honoring Confucius and disciples); Pan Chi (Crescent Pond); and the most comprehensive collection of authentic Imperial Calligraphy Plaques in the Sinosphere.
cultural_significance.intangible_culture_zh: 全臺保存最完整的八佾舞/六佾舞秋祭古禮，以及『拔智慧毛』等深具教育意義的民俗記憶。
cultural_significance.intangible_culture_en: Traditional ritual ceremonies featuring solemn bronze bells, stone chimes (Bianqing), ceremonial feather robes, and the historic ritual of sharing 'Wisdom Cattle Hair'.

foreign_visitor_guide.etiquette_tips_en: Unlike folk Taoist temples with incense smoke and fortune sticks, a Confucius Temple is a tranquil house of veneration without deity idols or fortune-telling. Please maintain a quiet and contemplative atmosphere. Do not climb on stone balustrades or touch historical timber brackets.
foreign_visitor_guide.etiquette_tips_zh: 孔廟非一般民間道教寺廟，不燒香、不抽籤，供奉神位而非神像，請保持莊重肅靜。
must_see_spots_en: 'First Academy of Taiwan' (全臺首學) wooden entrance plaque
Dacheng Hall interior featuring 15+ Imperial & Presidential Honor Boards
Minglun Hall (Hall of Moral Brightness) housing ancient Zhao Mengfu calligraphy stone rubbings
Three-story Wenchang Pavilion (God of Literature Pagoda)
must_see_spots_zh: 東大門『全臺首學』橫匾
大成殿內歷代清朝皇帝與歷任總統御匾群
明倫堂與趙孟頫書法石刻《大學》全文
三層樓古典文昌閣與泮池古樹庭園
foreign_visitor_guide.transportation_en: Take Tainan City Bus No. 2, 88, or Taiwan Tourist Shuttle 99 to 'Confucius Temple' stop, or take an easy 12-minute walk from Hayashi Department Store / National Museum of Taiwan Literature.
foreign_visitor_guide.transportation_zh: 搭乘大台南公車2號、88號至『孔廟』站下車；或從國立臺灣文學館/林百貨步行約5分鐘。
foreign_visitor_guide.best_time_to_visit: Early morning (8:30 AM - 10:30 AM) when the tree-shaded courtyards are peaceful and illuminated by soft sunlight.

metadata.source: Tainan Confucius Temple Foundation & Bureau of Cultural Heritage
